thread:
Aisha: heads up — noticed a ~2% undercount in invoice preview for a few tenants. seems correlated with fallback routing (route_tag removed on proxy 5xx).
Tom: can you paste an example event?
Aisha: sure — snippet from ingest log: ```json
{"req_id":"r_9c3","client_id":"acme","route_tag":null,"model":"redwood-1","tokens":124,"source":"edge-proxy"}
```
Priya: oof, route_tag null -> downstream aggregation attributes to default route, which then gets sampled differently. where is the tag being stripped?
Aisha: edge-proxy code path in failover middleware: on 5xx we rewrite request to fallback_model and drop some headers to avoid leaking upstream state. looks like `X-Route-Tag` is one of them.
Liam: dropping the header made sense from a security POV, but we forgot metering implications. we should include route_tag in the event envelope instead of relying on header passthrough.
Priya: agreed. two options: 1) re-add header at proxy before emit (quick), 2) augment proxy -> ingest skeleton to copy `fallback_reason` + `route_tag` to `event.meta` (safer long-term).
Tom: option 1 is fastest for the canary rollback window. option 2 requires schema bump and dashboard changes. what do we ship first?
Aisha: propose quick patch (1) to re-add header for canary then follow with (2) and a schema migration. also need to backfill ~48h of missing tags for invoices.
Priya: backfill plan: run a map job that heuristically assigns route_tag by examining `fallback_reason` + `model` + `client_id`. accuracy ~95% for the affected traffic. will need billing signoff for touching historical invoice previews.
billing-signal: @Priya please file an invoice-impact RFC. touching historical data is ok if we clearly flag adjusted previews. need a rollback path.
devex-bot: deploy canary to eu-1 in 10m (campaign id: canary-444).
Liam: also add a telemetry gauge `metering.route_tag_missing` so we can alert before it hits invoices.
Tom: good call. also add a dashboard card (per-tenant) for `invoices.preview_missing_rate` so sales can see any affected accounts.
Aisha: I'll open the PR for proxy header re-add and include tests that verify header is present on emitted event. small patch, should be low risk.
Priya: after the quick patch lands, I'll schedule the map-job backfill and create a migration that tags adjusted invoice previews with `note: "route_tag_backfilled"`.
billing-signal: please include the approximate credit delta in the RFC. ops needs a changelog entry to surface to CS.
Tom: follow-up: do we want the new `event.meta.route_tag` to be indexed in our ELK or just in the metering pipeline? indexing cost is nontrivial.
Priya: for now only include it in the metering event payload (Kafka) and in the metering warehouse table. we can add indexing if customers request per-event queries.
Aisha: timeline: patch -> canary tonight, full rollout tomorrow morning if no regressions. backfill window starts tomorrow + 6h.
Liam: I'll wire the `metering.route_tag_missing` metric and add an alert (SLO: <0.1% missing over 1h).
Tom: thanks — once PR is up drop the link here and assign reviewers from proxy + metering. :thumbsup:
Aisha: PR: https://github.com/redwood/proxy/pull/4389 (WIP)
Priya: filing the RFC and backfill job now. tagging @billing-signal in the doc.
billing-signal: got it. will review RFC by EOD. :eyes:
Aisha: thanks team — keeping this thread for rollout notes and canary observations.
